steps.caption: Partition Equal Subset Sum → is there a subset summing to 22 / 2 = 11? can[s] = some subset of the numbers seen so far sums to s. can[0] = True (empty set).
Item 1: every reachable sum s − 1 makes s reachable. Loop s from HIGH to LOW so 1 is used at most once (0/1 knapsack).
Item 5: every reachable sum s − 5 makes s reachable. Loop s from HIGH to LOW so 5 is used at most once (0/1 knapsack).
Item 11: every reachable sum s − 11 makes s reachable. Loop s from HIGH to LOW so 11 is used at most once (0/1 knapsack).
Item 5: every reachable sum s − 5 makes s reachable. Loop s from HIGH to LOW so 5 is used at most once (0/1 knapsack).
can[11] = True: {1, 5, 5} and {11}. O(n × target) time, O(target) space.
